summary: Remove the retry-branch mutation that appended "-retry" to the durable capture request id. A retry of an unresolved capture must replay the ORIGINAL request id verbatim so the provider returns the original result (idempotent same-id replay) instead of definitively refusing a mutated id and leaving a completed provider-side capture uncertified locally.

edits.rationale: The appended "-retry" suffix changed the id sent on the wire away from the durably committed one, so the provider did not recognize a repeat of the original capture request, refused it definitively, and the service moved the order back to APPROVED while a COMPLETED capture still existed provider-side (the precondition for a later double capture). Returning the operation with its original ProviderRequestID restores true same-id idempotent replay; the existing preflight GetOrder/completeCapture check in Capture already certifies an already-completed capture before anything is sent.
